subject: Private CP: IDP federation checklist & SAML/SCIM fallback plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Acme Identity Team <idp-team@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private CP: IDP federation checklist & SAML/SCIM fallback plan

Hi Paul / Acme identity team,

Following up from our call yesterday — thank you for the time. We want to lock in the minimal set of artifacts to get your Private Control Plane (VPC-hosted control plane) integrated with your IdP for SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning. Goal: make the initial federation testable within a two-week window, with a fallback SCIM-only path if the SAML attribute mapping needs extra cycles.

Requesting the following as first pass (if you can drop each item as attachments or links, that’d help):
- IdP metadata (entityID, x509 cert, ACS URL, SSO endpoint) — we can consume raw metadata XML.
- A sample SAML assertion (or assertion trace from a test login) showing attributes you send for name, email, groups, and role.
- SCIM provisioning matrix: which attributes and group sync cadence you support; whether you allow incremental deltas.
- Confirmation of a service-account for SCIM with OAuth2 bearer token or basic auth, and scope limitations.

Notes from our side:
- We will provide a test SP metadata file and ACS endpoint.
- Our preferred fallback is to accept SCIM sync for initial user provisioning and gate admin roles via SCIM group mapping until SAML mapping is validated.
- Security review items: cert rotation cadence, audit log retention for auth events, and whether your tenant issues persistentNameID vs transientNameID.

I’ve attached our integration checklist and a blank provisioning matrix to fill in. If helpful, cc your security ops contact and we’ll pull together the SOC/Security requirements.

Proposed next steps:
1) You share metadata + sample assertion (by EOD Mon 14 Apr)
2) Redwood provides SP metadata + short test plan (by Tue 15 Apr)
3) Mutually agree on test window and rollback steps

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Head of Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

- scim-provisioning-matrix.xlsx (blank)

From: Paul Turner <paul.turner@acme-corp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Identity Team <idp-team@acme-corp.com>, security-ops@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private CP: IDP federation checklist & SAML/SCIM fallback plan

Jordan — thanks, and great summary. Attaching our metadata and a sample assertion trace. A few clarifications from our side:
- We use Okta as primary IdP. Metadata attached (acme_idp_metadata.xml).
- We currently issue persistentNameID for SSO (we can switch to transient for test if needed).
- SCIM: we support RFC7644, support delta syncs, and can limit provisioning to specific groups.
- SCIM service account is available; token will be scoped to read/write /Users and /Groups only.

For roles: we generally map admin-level access via a top-level group ("Redwood_Admins"). We can expose group membership in SAML (memberOf / groups) or provide SCIM group sync to map roles. For speed, we recommend provisioning via SCIM first (create users + admin group), then validate SAML mapping for SSO.

I attached: acme_idp_metadata.xml and a small saml-test-results.txt with an anonymized assertion.

Availability: I can set aside a window Tues 15 Apr 10–12 PT for the live test; happy to extend if needed.

Paul Turner
Senior Identity Engineer, Acme Corp
paul.turner@acme-corp.com

Attachments:
- acme_idp_metadata.xml
- saml-test-results.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private CP: IDP federation checklist & SAML/SCIM fallback plan

Thanks Paul — this is perfect and moves us forward. A few implementation items from our provisioning side:

1) SCIM matrix: please confirm attribute names for primary email (we expect 'emails.value' or 'userName'). If you use 'userName' as the canonical identifier we can accept that; otherwise we will canonicalize to email.
2) Group mapping and admin escalation: we will map the 'Redwood_Admins' SCIM group to our control-plane admin role by group UUID; please provide the group UUID or allow us to read it in the first delta sync.
3) SCIM rate limits: we will request an initial full sync + deltas; confirm your rate limits so we can size backoff.

SAML test plan (short):
- Redwood provides SP metadata and test ACS URLs (will attach in separate email).
- Acme performs test login and shares SAML trace (already done, thanks).
- We validate assertion mapping: name, email, groups; then verify SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows.

If SAML mapping fails for admin role (timing or attribute naming), we will leave SCIM group mapping as authoritative for admin grant and add a short-lived admin escalation process for affected users. That reduces risk during rollout.

Mina, Karthik — can you confirm the SP metadata and whether we need a service account for the SCIM bootstrap read? I can draft the minimal doc for Acme to sign off.

— Marissa

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Paul Turner <paul.turner@acme-corp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private CP: IDP federation checklist & SAML/SCIM fallback plan

Paul / team — quick ops notes from Redwood implementation perspective: we validated the metadata file you sent and a couple of edge items to call out before the test window: 

- Certificate chain: your metadata contains an intermediate cert we do not trust by default in our staging CA bundle. For the test window we can pin the cert thumbprint; for production we will need either a public CA root chain or a rotation plan that we can audit.
- NameID format: persistentNameID is fine; for SP-initiated flows using NameID we prefer an email-format NameID when available. Please confirm if the NameID in the trace is an email or opaque ID.
- SCIM bootstrap: we will perform an initial full read followed by delta polling. We will need either a service-account token (preferred) or a short-lived OAuth client credential. Provide the token rotation cadence and a contact for SRE if token rotation causes sync failures.

Operational runbook (high level):
1) Pre-test: Acme provides metadata + token by EOD Mon 14 Apr (we need token for the bootstrap).
2) Stage deploy: Redwood deploys SP metadata to staging Control Plane and runs first SCIM full read.
3) Live test window: Tue 15 Apr 10–12 PT — run SSO test, exercise user login, check admin group mapping.
4) Post-test: revert any temporary read-only flags and confirm production plan.

I logged a short ticket with the team: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/browse/IDP-234 — it lists the work items and owners.

Two asks for Acme before we proceed:
- Provide SCIM token (or let us create a scoped service account)
- Confirm whether you can expose group UUIDs in the first delta sync (helps mapping)

Thanks — Mina

Attachments:
- none

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Private CP: IDP federation checklist & SAML/SCIM fallback plan

All — thanks for the fast turnaround and the metadata. Confirming next steps and owners so we have a mutual action plan:

Action items:
- Acme (Paul): provide SCIM service token OR allow Redwood to create a scoped service account by EOD Mon 14 Apr. Also confirm NameID format in the trace (email vs opaque).
- Redwood (Marissa): produce SP metadata and a one-page test plan + expected assertion mapping (by Mon night).
- Redwood (Mina + Karthik): perform staging deploy and run initial full SCIM sync prior to Tue test window.
- Both: test window Tue 15 Apr 10–12 PT; post-test debrief Wed 16 Apr 09–10 PT.

Fallback policy: if SAML attribute mapping prevents admin role validation during the test, we will rely on SCIM group mapping for admin grants for up to two weeks while SAML mapping is resolved. We discussed cert pinning for the test window; Acme to confirm if you can provide a trusted public chain for production.

I will prepare a short signoff doc and a DocuSign link for the minimal SOW for the staging work — planning to circulate by EOD. If we need to expand the test window, call out constraints now.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the run.

Jordan
